structured.answer: From what I read, it's like a fund that lends money to the state and the banks for a short time. It gave 3.25% against 1.8% on a one-year deposit, and you can take the money out on any trading day. But nothing is promised, I didn't find how much the management fee is, and it says the value can go down. So I won't move anything before I ask at the bank what the fee is and whether this suits money we might need.
